question: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
evidence: The first 4 strings of the event_date values in the event table can represent year; The difference of the total amount spent = SUBTRACT(spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2019, spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2020)
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching budget record.
gold: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS T1 LEFT JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
gold0: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event

d.request: Calculate the difference between the total amount spent in all Student_Club events in 2019 and in 2020 (using the first 4 characters of event_date as the year), and make sure to include events that have no matching budget record in the calculation.
d.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN COALESCE(b.spent, 0) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN COALESCE(b.spent, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
